articles.title: Tom Skerritt, ‘M*A*S*H’ and ‘Alien’ actor, dies at 93
articles.description: Heartfelt tributes are pouring in after an Emmy-winning actor died at 93
articles.content:
Emmy-winning actor Tom Skerritt, known for his memorable roles in “Picket Fences,” “Steel Magnolias” and “Top Gun,” has died. He was 93.
